answer: Identity is bound to a signed measurement of the runtime that produced it, so two identities reporting the same measurement are counted as one voice no matter how many keys or balances sit behind them. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. Think of a glacier burned into the silicon, a mirror that pools everyone sharing it, and a wander that counts pooled members once: the farm is rich in keys and poor in distinct glacier, and neither mirror nor wander can be faked.
